items.statement: The submitted workflow relaxes the supplied P1 periodic cell and reports force/stress convergence and chemical integrity.
items.expected_result: A reproducible relaxation is documented; the cell remains V8O25H8 and convergence diagnostics are explicit.
items.expected: The submitted workflow relaxes the supplied P1 periodic cell and reports force/stress convergence and chemical integrity.

items.statement: The submitted vibrational analysis identifies Γ-point modes and supports water/framework assignments with eigenvector, projection or tensor evidence.
items.expected_result: At least three water-dominated modes are individually identified and the analysis distinguishes them from framework modes.
items.expected: The submitted vibrational analysis identifies Γ-point modes and supports water/framework assignments with eigenvector, projection or tensor evidence.

items.statement: The water modes are the O–H symmetric stretch, O–H asymmetric stretch and O–H bend, and calculated values are close to measured values.
items.expected_result: The report assigns these three water modes and discusses agreement with the experimental 3562, 3756 and 1595 cm⁻¹ observations.
items.expected: The water modes are the O–H symmetric stretch, O–H asymmetric stretch and O–H bend, and calculated values are close to measured values.

items.statement: A hydrated-V2O5 feature near 890 cm⁻¹ is supported as water-related, while V–O–V modes are generally below 850 cm⁻¹ and weak in Raman activity.
items.expected_result: The report identifies a near-890 cm⁻¹ water-related feature and does not assign it solely to a V–O–V framework stretch.
items.expected: A hydrated-V2O5 feature near 890 cm⁻¹ is supported as water-related, while V–O–V modes are generally below 850 cm⁻¹ and weak in Raman activity.

items.statement: The unconstrained P1 model is more consistent with the PDF lattice than the constrained C2/m model.
items.expected_result: The comparison reports the P1 lattice as closer overall, with a=11.69 Å, b=3.63 Å, c=10.93 Å and β≈88.48° as the paper's calculated reference.
items.expected: The unconstrained P1 model is more consistent with the PDF lattice than the constrained C2/m model.
